const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('管理员详情字段白名单',()=>{pm.expect(Object.keys(b.data).sort()).deep.eq(["companyId","companyName","currentRegistrationVersion","currentVersion","id","registrationVersion","reviewComment","reviewStatus","reviewable","reviewedAt","reviewerUserId","snapshot","submittedAt"]);pm.expect(Object.keys(b.data.snapshot).sort()).deep.eq(["businessScope","businessStatus","creditCode","foundedDate","fullName","legalRepresentative","registeredAddress","registeredCapital"]);});const requests=[{kind:'review',method:'PUT',url:'/admin/company/registration-reviews/'+b.data.id+'/decision',token:pm.collectionVariables.get('rrToken7'),body:{registrationVersion:b.data.registrationVersion,decision:'APPROVE'}},{kind:'edit',method:'PUT',url:'/company',token:pm.collectionVariables.get('rrToken5'),body:{...JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('rrForm')),fullName:'并发工商资料'+(b.data.registrationVersion+1)}}];let done=0;const outcomes=[];requests.forEach((r,index)=>setTimeout(()=>{const started=Date.now();pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('rrHost')+r.url,method:r.method,header:{Authorization:'Bearer '+r.token,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:{mode:'raw',raw:JSON.stringify(r.body)}},(err,res)=>{pm.test('并发子请求可达',()=>pm.expect(err).eq(null));if(!err)outcomes.push({kind:r.kind,code:res.json().code,started,ended:Date.now()});if(++done===2){console.log('RR_RACE='+JSON.stringify(outcomes));pm.test('请求时间真实重叠',()=>pm.expect(Math.max(...outcomes.map(x=>x.started))).below(Math.min(...outcomes.map(x=>x.ended))));pm.test('并发结果符合状态规则',()=>{pm.expect(outcomes.map(x=>x.code).sort()).deep.eq([200,200]);});pm.collectionVariables.set('rrRace',JSON.stringify(outcomes));}});},index*100));

item.name: 135 先审批形成第二版历史证据

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('管理员详情字段白名单',()=>{pm.expect(Object.keys(b.data).sort()).deep.eq(["companyId","companyName","currentRegistrationVersion","currentVersion","id","registrationVersion","reviewComment","reviewStatus","reviewable","reviewedAt","reviewerUserId","snapshot","submittedAt"]);pm.expect(Object.keys(b.data.snapshot).sort()).deep.eq(["businessScope","businessStatus","creditCode","foundedDate","fullName","legalRepresentative","registeredAddress","registeredCapital"]);});pm.test('审核完成后版本已推进',()=>{pm.expect(b.data.reviewStatus).eq('APPROVED');pm.expect(b.data.registrationVersion).eq(2);pm.expect(b.data.currentRegistrationVersion).eq(3);pm.expect(b.data.currentVersion).eq(false);});

item.name: 136 先审批再编辑时新版仍待审

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('仅第二版核验且第三版未核验',()=>{pm.expect(b.data.registrationVersion).eq(3);pm.expect(b.data.verifiedRegistrationVersion).eq(2);pm.expect(b.data.registrationReviewStatus).eq('PENDING');pm.expect(b.data.registrationVerified).eq(false);});
